messages:
nora: Heads-up: opening a tiny docs PR to add a compact function-calling example and a migration note for structured output parsing. Need quick link + snippet checks.

sam: please include a null-result and an error path. reviewers want both shown.

nora: draft example (super small):
```
User: 'Price for sku 777'
Assistant -> call price_lookup(sku=777)
Tool returns: {"price_cents":1999, "currency": "USD"}
Assistant final: {"price_display": "$19.99"}
```

diego: add a compact JSON Schema inline: {"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]} and a one-line note: price_cents may be null on tool failure.

sam: short SDK hints: JS one-liner and Py one-liner showing prefered parser helper vs raw output. Also avoid wording that implies our runtime enforces the schema; state parsing/validation is client-side.

nora: JS: `const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(resp)`; Py: `parsed = validate_structured(resp)` (docs helper). I'll add an eval case in the PR body for QA: prompt -> expected {"price_display": "$19.99"}.

docs-bot: docs-ci: "staging build started for PR #3520"

diego: tiny copy nit: reword guardrails sentence to 'docs recommend validating structured output on the client side.'

nora: updated wording & added anchors for links. running ./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh then pushing. squashing into commits: example, schema, snippets, links.

docs-bot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3520"

sam: quick review done, minor comment on the JS snippet formatting.

nora: fixed, pushed, merging now. I'll open a follow-up issue for an expanded runbook with canonical shim functions. thanks! :thumbsup:
